about.title: The main forum for Software Engineering & Development in Brazil
about.p1: Promoted by the Brazilian Computer Society (SBC), CBSOFT brings together, once a year, four national symposia into a single program. Researchers, graduate students and industry professionals share results, discuss open problems and build the research agenda for Software Engineering, Programming Languages, Reusable Architectures and Software Testing in Brazil.
about.p2: In 2027 the congress arrives in Belo Horizonte, one of Brazil's most active innovation and startup hubs — with a program that mixes scientific tracks, an industry track, tutorials, tool demonstrations and a thesis & dissertation contest.

aboutPage.title: About CBSoft
aboutPage.highlightEditionRest: of the Brazilian Conference on Software
aboutPage.p1: The Brazilian Conference on Software: Theory and Practice (CBSoft) is held annually by the Brazilian Computer Society (SBC) to foster and encourage the exchange of experiences among researchers and professionals from industry and academia on the latest practical and theoretical research, trends and innovations in software. Held since 2010 as the umbrella event for the Brazilian software symposia promoted by SBC, CBSoft has become one of the leading events of the Brazilian scientific community in Computing.
aboutPage.p2: In 2027, the XVIII edition of CBSoft will be held in person in Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais. The official dates of the event are yet to be defined. This edition brings together four traditional events held annually by the Brazilian Software Engineering community:
aboutPage.activitiesLead: The CBSoft program includes technical sessions with scientific paper presentations, keynotes by renowned Brazilian and international researchers, panel discussions, workshops, and tool demonstrations.
aboutPage.activitiesClosing: All of these activities, of interest to the Software Engineering community and related areas of software systems development, aim to disseminate knowledge and discuss important questions related to research, development and innovation, both in Brazil and worldwide.
